description: A U1 whose start G-code moves before homing and lacks the stock pre-print sequence: the guard (on by default) prints the stock sequence instead and says so. (The configured start G-code still appears in the settings at the end of the file.)
contains: ; Magpie: the start G-code lacked the Snapmaker U1 pre-print sequence; the stock U1 start G-code replaced it
